description: List the recent publish history for a site (newest first), so you can undo a change. Pass token, or name+project_key. Each publish is a version; use a version number with rollback_website to restore it. Returns structuredContent { status, url, current_version, count, versions:[{ version, published_at, sha, is_current }] }.
name: list_versions

note.description: The label passed at publish (e.g. "added pricing").

rollbackable.description: False if its snapshot has aged out (only the last 5 are retained) — rollback_website would reject it.

sha.description: Stable content hash for this version (compare to detect change).

title: List site versions
